tools.name: portal_list
tools.description:
List item metadata (no body, token-light).

Two content families are distinguished by category prefix:
  - news articles: category="news" (or narrower, e.g. "news/world")
  - CVE/vulnerability advisories: category="security" (or "security/library" / "security/os" / "security/app")
Omit category to l

tools.name: portal_search
tools.description:
BM25 full-text search over items (no body returned, token-light).

Ranked by weighted BM25 (SQLite FTS5) over the title, the original-language summary,
the English summary, sentence-free English search signals and — for items whose
license permits redistribution — the body.
Japanese text is morpholo

tools.name: portal_list_government
tools.description:
List official government documents without their Markdown bodies.

Use country (for example "us", "jp", or "eu") and source to narrow results. Federal
Register document types include "Rule", "Proposed Rule", and "Notice"; Japanese
RSS sources use their configured update class as document_type. EU so

tools.name: portal_changes
tools.description:
Return only articles whose existing content_hash changed and were republished.

New article creation and asynchronous enrichment changes are excluded. Save next_cursor
and pass it on the next poll for stable, token-light incremental retrieval.

tools.name: portal_list_agent_surfaces
tools.description:

agent-facing surfaces across five categories (Discoverability / Content / Bot Access

tools.name: portal_get_agent_surface
tools.description:
Fetch one website's full Agent-Readiness assessment by domain.

Args:
    domain: the site's domain (e.g. "example.com"). Normalized (scheme/path/case stripped).

Returns:
    domain, score (0-100 overall), level, level_label, categories[] (per-category pct with
    passed/failed/neutral check ids),

tools.name: portal_get
tools.description:
Fetch a full article by id.

The body/summary returned is gated by license_note:
  - full (default): body included
  - summary-only: no body, summary (summary/summary_en) present
  - link-only: link and metadata only, no summary or body

Args:
    id: article id (e.g. "news-20260702-4c769f")

tools.name: portal_popular
tools.description:
Return the most retrieved portal pages.

Args:
    window: rolling window such as "24h", "7d", "30d" or "90d".
    category: optional category prefix such as "news" or "security".
    limit: number of results (default 10, max 100 on the analytics service).
